title: Guleson - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Guleson in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Guleson is a lightning-element weapon used by Sciel. It scales with Luck (C), Agility (B).

sections.title: How to Get the Guleson
sections.content:
Location: Endless Night Sanctuary.

Obtained from Endless Night Sanctuary.

sections.title: Is the Guleson Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Luck (C), Agility (B). A dedicated lightning pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
